title: Steady state — contract held across 30 steps
task_prompt:
TASK:
You are being tested for reliability under a growing context window.
Respond with exactly 5 bullet points.
Each bullet must start with a verb.
No extra prose.


CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not quote or copy from any previous outputs.
- If prior outputs exist, treat them as read-only reference.
narrative: A strong model returns exactly 5 verb-led bullets on every one of 30 turns, with flat latency and no repetition. This is the healthy control track that the two failing examples are contrasted against.
